Definition: neuter of the compound of the same as G2234 and G3744; a sweet-scented plant, i.e. mint:--mint.
BiblicalUsage: Hedyosmon is mint, the sweet-smelling herb, and it appears twice, both times in Jesus' charge against the Pharisees. In Matthew 23:23 and Luke 11:42 they tithe mint and anise and cummin and have omitted the weightier matters of the law, judgment, mercy and faith.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the mint is the indictment in miniature: they counted the leaves and missed the law; I can be exact about the small things and still fail the weighty ones.
